## Professional Summary

Full-Stack Developer with a strong foundational background built *before* the AI era — and now leveraging it as a force multiplier. I architect and ship production-grade systems (custom POS platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, edge-native APIs) independently, from requirements to deployment. My pre-AI foundation means I understand *why* code works, not just how to generate it — so I can use AI tools strategically to maximize output while keeping costs minimal for clients. I can vibe-code when speed is the priority, but I bring the engineering discipline to know when not to. Equally comfortable in franchise operations, Meta Ads, and CRM — making me a rare hybrid of technical depth and business execution.
